scope: Economato guide and documentary consistency; read-only audit of root integration

registration.note: Read-only comparison after final frozen registration following soffit and camera corrections; no production file was changed by this reviewer.

generatorGuard.testEnvironment: Isolated temporary copy of the generator and a registered sentinel guide

documentaryDecisions.recentStatus: Municipal January 2026 works report, with a November 18 firsthand visit chronicle used as attributed secondary corroboration
documentaryDecisions.roofSection: Remove high coverings and ceilings, retain intermediate floor slab
documentaryDecisions.upperLevelSmaller: One two-storey cadastral part plus four single-storey parts; upper level is smaller than the whole lower ensemble. The main body's two storeys share an interpreted envelope.

independentVisualReview.method: Inspection of exported PNGs, not browser rendering
independentVisualReview.findings: No material issue observed: mobile focus circles remain individually readable; upper floor shows stops 9 and 15; north and scale are present; context alignment follows the parcel and retains documented access.

initialFindings: Decorative floor pattern was visible on the underside of the ground-floor ceiling in nave-central and galeria; documented soffits are plain.
Opposite residential blocks obstructed the conjunto and entorno views; fachada also showed a prominent opposite block and clipped the near wing.
threeDimensionalRenders.otherInitialConclusions: Historical facade sequence, cylindrical supports, beams, upper-floor treatment and section semantics were reasonable within the explicitly interpretive model. No completed CEAM or invented basement interior was observed.
threeDimensionalRenders.correctionStatus: All seven regenerated CPU render PNGs independently inspected; the documented soffit error and camera-obstruction issues are visually resolved.

finalReview.method: Direct visual inspection of exported CPU render PNGs; not browser or WebGL validation.

views.finding: Corrected framing exposes all three roofed bodies and the two porticoes, with Begoña and the rear garden providing context.
Corrected framing makes the three facade bodies, both recessed porticoes and the avenue legible without the previous opposite-block obstruction.
Plain soffit visually confirmed; decorative hydraulic pattern remains on the floor only. Cylindrical supports and beams remain legible.
Plain soffit visually confirmed along the connecting interior; no repeated floor decoration on the ceiling.
Plain upper ceiling, cylindrical supports and readable windows; no new material issue observed.
Intermediate floor slab remains visible and intact apart from the interpreted stair opening; lower annexes retain their coverings.
Corrected view shows the continuous avenue between the Economato and the opposite residential frontage, with Begoña visible.

finalReview.interpretationLimit: Proportions, exact interior layout, furniture, colors and unmeasured heights remain interpretive as stated in the guide; these images are not evidence of a completed CEAM or an exact current survey.
